newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil plans Troll condensate line to Mongstad.
newsitem.headline: Statoil plans Troll condensate line to Mongstad.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it planned to lay a 12-inch pipeline to transport Troll condensate from the gas treatment plant at Kollsnes outside Bergen to its Mongstad refinery.
The two plants, and Norsk Hydro's crude oil terminal at Sture, are all within 30 km of each other on the west coast of Norway. Each are operated independently.
Condensate from the North Sea Troll field is currently pumped from Kollsnes to Sture for export.
"But (it) will be worth more if used as feedstock for the Mongstad refinery and sold," Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
The pipeline will cost around 350 million crowns and will be suplemented by a new 90 million crown condensate splitter at Mongstad.
Statoil said its management board was due to consider the proposal on April 29.
